summary: Robo.ai Inc., a Dubai-domiciled, Cayman-incorporated foreign private issuer listed on a US exchange, filed a Form 6-K furnishing the Sixth Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association adopted by special resolution on 22 September 2026, together with a press release reporting the results of an Extraordinary General Meeting. The amendments reset authorized share capital at US$4,000,000 across 2,000,000,000 shares, comprising 250,000,000 Class A and 1,750,000,000 Class B ordinary shares at US$0.002 par. No transaction, stake, price, premium or board recommendation is stated. This is a routine governance and charter-restatement filing; watch only for future capital-structure actions enabled by the dual-class framework.
